summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by MindWalk Holdings Corp. (Nasdaq: HYFT) disclosing preclinical data on its HYFT computational platform's dengue vaccine program. The filing reports that immunogens designed using HYFT predictions elicited cross-reactive antibodies against all four dengue serotypes in animal studies. There are no deal terms, strategic changes, or corporate events being announced; it is purely a business update on R&D progress. The filing does not involve any special situation category such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring.
